messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: elevated 5xx + gateway timeouts detected for /v1/generate in us-west1. 5xx rate ~18% over 5m, p95 latency > 5s. Paging oncall: @raj :rotating_light:
raj (oncall): on it. joining from phone, grabbing alerts and logs. switching to incident channel.
maria (SRE): I can see queue depth climbing on batching-scheduler gw-west-2. head-of-line blocking looks likely — many batches stuck in `batch_wait`. KV prefetch latencies spiking.
ben (runtime): confirming metrics: scheduler.queue_len per-worker jumped 40->240 in 10m, max_batch threshold 200 is hit and not progressing. many workers showing `batch_wait: stuck` in /var/log/runtime.log.
clara (eng-ml): did we roll any model or change batching hints last night? we pushed 7b-v2 quantized but region pinned.
ben (runtime): no model rollout in us-west1. there was a heuristic change to batching hint propagation at 03:12 UTC but only for new clusters. not expected here. digging into logs now.
maria (SRE): sample from scheduler log ->
```
[2026-03-15T03:09:12Z] worker=gw-west-2-07 batch_id=9876 state=batch_wait reason=kvcache-prefetch timeout=120s
[2026-03-15T03:09:13Z] worker=gw-west-2-07 batch_id=9877 state=batch_wait reason=kvcache-prefetch timeout=120s
[2026-03-15T03:10:01Z] gateway=gw-front-02 upstream=runtime-err code=504 msg=timeout waiting for batch
```
ben (runtime): looks like KV prefetch requests to redis-cluster-west are timing out and blocking batch formation. head-of-line: long-running batches are preventing newer requests from being batched.
alice (support): customers are opening tickets and seeing 5xx spikes in their dashboards. CS notified. any ETA for mitigation?
maria (SRE): quick mitigation options:
- temporarily reduce `max_batch_size` and `max_batch_delay` to force smaller, faster batches (reduces HOL but increases tokens/sec).
- route a fraction of traffic to us-east1 until kv cluster stabilizes.
- force-evict stuck batches on hotspot nodes (manual).
- scale up scheduler pool for gw-west-2 (if capacity available).
raj (oncall): prioritize routing + reduce batch size, then evict long-running batches if still high. start with routing 30% to us-east1.
ben (runtime): commands to run (control plane):
```
# shift 30% of traffic from us-west1 to us-east1
redwood route update --from-region us-west1 --to-region us-east1 --weight 30 --policy gradual
# reduce batch size/delay on runtime group gw-west-2
redwood runtime config set --group gw-west-2 scheduler.max_batch_size 32
redwood runtime config set --group gw-west-2 scheduler.max_batch_delay_ms 80
```
deploy-bot: route update accepted, starting gradual shift (30%) — job id: j-98f3a.
maria (SRE): I'm kicking off drain script on the three hotspot nodes to avoid new batches hitting them: `./scripts/drain-scheduler.sh gw-west-2-0{5,6,7}`
clara (eng-ml): I'll prepare a quick fallback in the KV prefetch path to return stale cached values if prefetch times out (avoids blocking batch creation). can canary to one instance.
simon (prod): traffic shift visible — about 28% now to us-east1. 5xx rate dropped from 18% -> 6% in last 2m. p95 latency improving to ~1.2s. still tail 5xx from gw-west-2 nodes.
ben (runtime): applied reduced batch size on gw-west-2. new batches form faster, throughput dip but latency improved. manual eviction started for batch_ids > 9800.
alice (support): messaging to customers drafted: "We're mitigating an outage affecting generation endpoints in us-west1. We've rerouted traffic and adjusted runtime batching to reduce errors and latency. Engineering is investigating root cause and will update in 30m." want review before sending?
raj (oncall): send now, include incident tracker link. I'll keep paging open; handing to infra shift after 30m once stable.
maria (SRE): status update -> KV cluster showing intermittent timeout spikes, ops on redis cluster investigating. meanwhile eviction + routing reduced error to ~3-4%. we'll continue draining and rebalancing.
clara (eng-ml): canary patch for prefetch fallback deployed to one runtime in gw-west-2-05. observed 0 blocked batches there for 1m. good sign.
ben (runtime): promoting canary to remaining drained nodes as they come back. scheduling a follow-up to add non-blocking prefetch by default.
simon (prod): customer-facing impact: high-traffic customers saw retries and a few failed requests in the 03:08-03:18 window. no large data loss. CS will follow up with affected customers.
raj (oncall): plan: keep routing 30% for next 20m, continue draining->promote canary, then gradually shift back once KV stable. if 5xx >5% again, escalate to platform lead.
deploy-bot: routing job j-98f3a completed: 30% -> us-east1.
maria (SRE): marking manual mitigations in incident doc, collecting heap and thread dumps from stuck workers for postmortem.
alice (support): customer note sent. tickets updated.
raj (oncall): closing paging for now — will monitor. re-open if alerts cross threshold. thanks all for quick pivot. :thumbsup:
incident-bot: UPDATE: 5xx rate back to baseline (~1.1%). p95 ~720ms. Incident moved to follow-up/triage. Incident ticket: INC-3201234567.
